notes: Researched 2026-11-14. Neither retailer offers a public API to fill a cart, so 'ordering' means copying a store-formatted list and opening the store's app or site; the family reviews and checks out. Anything marked unconfirmed could not be verified from a retailer page and should be shown with that caveat.

sams.name: Sam's Club
services: Free Curbside Pickup — no order minimum or fees (per the club page)
Delivery as soon as 1 hour, $10 extra, no minimum (per the club page)
Scan & Go in the app (skip the checkout line)

links.searchTemplateNote: Replace {query} with the item words joined by '+' (e.g. https://www.samsclub.com/s/canned+beans).

android.name: Sam's Club
android.note: Google Play package id not confirmed; link opens a Play Store search.

handoff.listFormat: One item per line, plain words plus pack size, e.g. 'Member's Mark chicken breasts 10 lb — 1'. Sam's search works best with short item names.
steps: Tap Copy & open Sam's Club — your list is copied.
In the Sam's Club app, tap Search and paste (or type) one item at a time, then tap Add to cart. Things you've bought before are quickest from your past purchases.
Choose Curbside Pickup at Addison (free, no minimum) or Delivery, and check out.
Shopping in the club instead? Use Scan & Go in the app and check items off here as you go.
confirmed: Curbside Pickup is free with no minimum and Delivery is $10 extra, per the Addison club page (2026-11-14).
Scan & Go is in the Sam's Club app (App Store description).
unconfirmed: No 'paste a whole list' import was found for Sam's Club; the app's App Store notes (through v26.11.21, Nov 2026) mention no shopping-list import or AI assistant.
Sam's Club has saved shopping lists and a reorder/past-purchases view on the website and app, but the exact menu path was not confirmed (the help article could not be read).

Walmart's 'Sparky' AI assistant: the Sam's Club app's universal-link file (fetched 2026-11-15) includes /sparkyAssistant and /sparkyEssentials paths, so a Sparky assistant appears to exist in the Sam's app — but whether it can take a pasted shopping list and fill the cart is not confirmed.

coupons.label: Sam's Instant Savings
coupons.pageTitle: Sam's Club November 2026 Instant Savings & Deals (event Oct 28 – Nov 29, 2026)
coupons.clipAllNote: Nothing to clip — Sam's Club doesn't use digital coupons.
appSteps: Nothing to clip: Instant Savings come off automatically for members — the price you see already includes them.
Shopping in the club or with Scan & Go? Just scan your membership (or use the app) and the savings apply.
Ordering Curbside Pickup or delivery? Savings show in your cart while the event runs.
Tap the Instant Savings link to see this month's deals before you go.
coupons.note: Sam's describes Instant Savings as 'automatic member discounts … online and in-club', valid in U.S. clubs with a U.S. membership during each event (current: Oct 28 – Nov 29, 2026). That they apply inside Scan & Go comes from consumer guides, not a Sam's page — unconfirmed but expected.

search.verified: Yes — samsclub.com/s/tomatoes, /s/mustard and /s/canned+beans returned product results on 2026-11-14.

app.note: The Sam's Club app's apple-app-site-association file (fetched 2026-11-15) opens /search/*, /ip/*, /p/*, /b/*, /c/*, /browse/*, /lists/*, /orders/*, /savings and /instantsavings* in the iPhone app, but NOT /s/* — so /s/{q} opens Safari. Whether /search/{q} shows results in the app wasn't tested; product pages (/ip/…, /p/…) do open in the app.

purchaseHistory.web: Sign in at samsclub.com → Account → Purchase History (in-club and online purchases are both tied to the membership; open a trip to see its receipt).
purchaseHistory.urlStatus: unconfirmed — /orders/* is in the app's universal-link list; the exact Purchase History URL wasn't loaded
purchaseHistory.app: Sam's Club app → Account → Purchase History → pick a trip.

jewel.name: Jewel-Osco
jewel.storeNumberNote: From the store's own shopping links (storeId=3340).
jewel.address: 599 E Roosevelt Rd, Glen Ellyn, IL 60137

hours.pharmacy: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM; Sat–Sun 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (second hours table on the store page; label not explicit)

services: Grocery delivery, plus Flash delivery (as soon as 30 minutes in select areas)
Jewel-Osco for U rewards and digital coupons
SNAP EBT online and in store

handoff.listFormat: Plain list, one item per line with an amount, e.g. 'Signature Select spaghetti, 16 oz — 2'. The assistant matches each line to a product.
steps: Tap Copy & open Jewel-Osco — your list is copied.
In the Jewel-Osco app, tap Ask AI (on jewelosco.com it's the AI Shopping Assistant in Meals Hub), paste the list, and ask it to add everything to your cart.
Check each match (brand and size) in the cart and make sure the store is Roosevelt & Park, Glen Ellyn.
Choose DriveUp & Go pickup or delivery and check out. If Ask AI isn't there, search each item and tap Add.
confirmed: Albertsons' AI Shopping Assistant (announced Dec 3, 2025) lets you type a list or upload a picture of a written grocery list and finds products for each item; it is on all banner websites, including Jewel-Osco, in Meals Hub.
At launch it was website-only, with the mobile apps planned for early 2026.
The Jewel-Osco app listing (updated Nov 11, 2026) advertises 'Ask AI' and building repeatable shopping lists and grocery lists from recipes.
unconfirmed: The exact button path to Ask AI inside the Jewel-Osco app.
Whether the in-app Ask AI accepts a pasted multi-item list the same way the website assistant does.

coupons.label: Clip Jewel coupons
coupons.pageTitle: Deals+ | Jewel-Osco (for U digital coupons; sign-in required)
coupons.clipAllNote: We could not find a 'Clip All' button on Jewel-Osco's site or in its for U help pages — plan on tapping Clip on each deal (use Categories to find what's on your list).
appSteps: Open the Jewel-Osco app and sign in to your for U account.
Tap for U Deals at the top (or Deals+ in the bottom bar).
Tap Clip on each deal you'll use — use Categories to jump to things on this week's list.
Check Clipped Deals; clipped offers come off automatically at checkout when you enter your phone number or scan the app (online orders: account linked to for U).
coupons.note: The planner can't clip coupons for you — Jewel-Osco has no public API and the app never stores your Jewel password. Clip before you shop; deals clipped after checkout don't count.

search.verified: Partly — the URL loads a 'Search Results | Jewel-Osco' page (2026-11-15); results render with JavaScript in a real browser and depend on the selected store (set Roosevelt & Park, Glen Ellyn).

app.note: Jewel-Osco's apple-app-site-association file lists only /home* for the iPhone app (fetched 2026-11-15), so search and product links open in Safari, not the app. In the app, tap the search bar and paste the product name.

purchaseHistory.web: Sign in at jewelosco.com → your name → Orders (online orders), and Buy It Again (items you've purchased, for reordering).
purchaseHistory.urlStatus: paths seen on business.jewelosco.com's FAQ (business.jewelosco.com/order-account/orders and /shop/purchases/buy-it-again.html); the www paths are assumed to match
purchaseHistory.inStore: Jewel's FAQ mentions 'online or in-store past purchase history' but doesn't say where in-store purchases appear; Buy It Again is the likeliest place (purchases tied to the for U phone number) — unconfirmed. Customer Service: (877) 505-4040.
